title: seL4 Formal Verification
root_cause: Traditional kernels have no correctness proof. Bugs in kernel code violate all application-level security. seL4 uses capability model with formal proof of functional correctness.
resolution_type: Machine-checked proof in Isabelle/HOL. 8700 lines of C, 200K lines of proof. Capability-based access control with proof of integrity and confidentiality.
